raw_value_rules.notes: Never overwrite or discard the exact source text.
Observed in current PG62 master; validate against headings and more than one source revision before promoting.
Existing parser maps UNCH to numeric zero; the master records that mapping as needing an explicit approved semantic rule, not an implicit parser behavior.
The meaning and scope of the B marker are not assumed here. Preserve the raw token and do not silently discard the marker until the official legend is reviewed.
A detached sign must not be joined to a number based on text order alone.

normalization_rules.rule: Use decimal arithmetic; preserve source precision and exact raw token. No binary floating-point normalization.
Parse only after field identity is established. A valid integer is not evidence that the column is correct.
Keep original code points. Any normalized dash equivalence must be explicit and retain original text/code points.
Unknown or ambiguous glyphs produce UNRESOLVED/QUARANTINE, never an inferred replacement.
